notes.title: Fortune Handlers Update Journal #2
notes.notes:
🎲 Meet a new update for Fortune Handlers!

We continue working on the game and your feedback plays the most important role here! Based on your reviews we made a new patch:

- We added a new logic for environmental elements. Now you need to drag dice into them.
- There was an indication of the cooldown for the characters' abilities. In the new update, the player sees when the ability will be available.
- The priority of the wave of new enemies. There will not be the same waves of enemies one by one.
- Also, the enemies have a progress indication. It means that the player immediately sees when the dice are rolled and what options fell out to his characters as well as to their enemies.

I hope you will appreciate these changes and find the battles more breathtaking. 

Also, it would be nice if leave us a comment on what you want to know about Fortune Handlers development. I will share it with you!

notes.title: Fortune Handlers Update Journal #1
notes.notes:
Hey! ːsteamhappyː

The last few weeks were hard, the team has been working on new features and visuals after your feedback, folks. We want to publish regular development logs to note the history of Fortune Handlers.

So today we are ready to release our first dev log. For the last two weeks, the team has been working on:
- Almost a new field configuration. It's now divided vertically.
- Moreover, there is also a global map and one dungeon for the battle. Now it's more about the future look of the game, and later there will be a map and you can choose dungeons.
- In addition, there is a start screen with the full description of the characters, and a new look of the battles and opponents.
- A new tutorial because of all these changes :D

That's all for now, but I will show you all the details in the next posts. If you want to see everything for yourself join our open test and follow the next Dev Log News!

notes.title: The first open playtest is completed
notes.notes:
The first playtest is completed.

Guys, thank you so much for participating in the playtest and showing your interest in Fortune Handlers! 🎲 

We've got so many applicants and your feedback is great. It is super valuable for us and even more than we expected!

Now the playtest is over and the team is gonna analyze it to bring new content to the game. We hope you will like it ːsteamhappyː

Join our next playtest on December 9. Your participation will help us to develop the game and make it cool!

notes.title: Open Playtest
notes.notes:
Thank you for signing up for the playtest! There are more participants than we expected!

Please, note that the playtest is open to everyone until Monday. If you are full of emotions and feedback the team would really appreciate you filling out the form after the test.

Here is a link to it: https://forms.gle/osJKVCAQAh7JDL5L7

There is a short survey included, but it would be super helpful if you fill out the extended version. We hope you will leave us a lot of feedback ^-^!

Also, it would be especially valuable if you record your gameplay and attach it to the feedback survey.

We plan to open the playtest every two weeks on the weekends. So the next one is going to be from the 2d up to the 5th of December. But if there are too many applicants, we can do it earlier! :D

notes.title: Let the story begin
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone!

With this post we are launching the Steam Fortune Handlers community here.
It's a new indie game made by a small team of game developers and Joy Way as a publisher.

The main idea is to make a collectible card game with a mix of a classic RPG in a realistic fantasy setting.

At the moment we are working on a further project roadmap and preparing for the White Nights Showcase in Tev Aviv (November 23-24).

All news, updates, dev logs and other stuff concerning Fortune Handlers development will be posted here for our players asap. You will see live how the game is developing and even participate in it. Feel free to post your suggestions and feedback to the community. Every player is super valuable for us!
